lines.zh: 沉重的脚步声在岩浆中回响。
lines.en: Heavy footsteps echo in the lava.

lines.zh: 灼热的岩浆中，它挪动着步伐。
lines.en: It moves through the molten lava.

lines.zh: 它缓慢地走过熔岩平原。
lines.en: It slowly walks across the lava plains.

lines.zh: 发出微弱的嘶嘶声，脚步声沉重。
lines.en: It emits a faint sssss, heavy footsteps.

lines.zh: 在岩浆中，它的每一步都留下痕迹。
lines.en: In the lava, each step leaves a mark.

lines.zh: 岩浆中，它沉重地挪动着。
lines.en: It moves heavily in the lava.

lines.zh: 沉重的脚步声在熔岩上响起。
lines.en: Heavy footsteps resound on the lava.

lines.zh: 它缓慢而坚定地行走在岩浆中。
lines.en: It slowly and firmly walks in the lava.

lines.zh: 在岩浆中，它留下灼热的脚印。
lines.en: In the lava, it leaves hot footprints.
It slowly moves through the lava.

lines.zh: 他赤脚踩在灼热的岩上。
lines.en: He walks barefoot on the scorching rock.

lines.zh: 瘦小的身影在下界缓行。
lines.en: A small thin figure inches along the nether.
It quietly stays in the lava.

lines.zh: 在岩浆中，它静静地站立。
lines.en: It stands quietly in the lava.

lines.zh: 它在岩浆中静静地不动。
lines.en: It quietly stands still in the lava.

lines.zh: 岩浆中的它仿佛一尊雕像。
lines.en: It stands like a statue in the lava.

lines.zh: 它在岩浆中缓缓地呼吸。
lines.en: It breathes slowly in the lava.

lines.zh: 在岩浆中，它静静地驻足。
lines.en: It pauses quietly in the lava.

lines.zh: 它静静地待在这片炙热的土地上。
lines.en: It quietly stays on this scorching land.

lines.zh: 它在岩浆中安静地立着。
lines.en: It stands quietly in the lava.

lines.zh: 它在岩浆中静静地沉思。
lines.en: It quietly ponders in the lava.

lines.zh: 在岩浆中，它静静地屹立。
lines.en: It stands quietly in the lava.

lines.zh: 我缩着肩，眼睛不敢离开你。
lines.en: Hunched, I keep my eyes fixed on you.
It notices you and looks at you.
It looks at you, assessing.
It fixes its gaze on you, coldly.
It carefully observes you.

lines.zh: 它向你投来审视的目光。
lines.en: It casts a scrutinizing glance at you.
It looks at you with caution.

lines.zh: 它注意到了你，目光坚定。
lines.en: It notices you, its gaze firm.

lines.zh: 它盯着你看，似乎在寻找机会。
lines.en: It stares at you, searching for an opportunity.
It focuses on you, its gaze sharp.

lines.zh: 肉体在燃烧，痛苦如烙印。
lines.en: Scorching pain marks my flesh.
Wounds are painful.
I am broken.
Flesh can't hold on.

lines.zh: 痛苦难忍，仿佛灵魂出窍。
lines.en: Pain is unbearable.
Injured, breaths are weak.
Wounds are fatal.
Struggle deepens the wounds.
Wounds remind me to survive.

lines.zh: 肉体极限，再也支撑不住。
lines.en: Flesh is at its limit.
Be careful, you're tempting me!

lines.zh: 别过来，这片屋后是我的地方。
lines.en: Stay back; behind this house is my place.
Food is over there, don't hesitate!
I have food in my cave!
Get away from my food, or else!

lines.zh: 你身上有饭团的味道吗？
lines.en: Do you smell of rice balls?
One step closer and I will call for help.
Don't disturb my lunch!
I saw that cake first.
You're too close, go away!

lines.zh: 你踩到我的脚了，退开一点。
lines.en: You stepped on my foot. Back off a little.
I am only a woodcutter's child.

lines.zh: 肩膀撞疼了，我揉了两下。
lines.en: My shoulder hurts; I rub it twice.

lines.zh: 别推，我虽然瘦也站得稳。
lines.en: Do not shove me; thin as I am, I stand firm.
You bumped into me again!
I am not a demon yet. Do not fear me.
You used too much force!
Don't use so much force!
You knocked me away!

lines.zh: 我抬手挡了一下，差点摔倒。
lines.en: I raise an arm to block and nearly fall.

lines.zh: 我还没有变成鬼，先别怕我。
lines.en: I am not a demon yet. Don't fear me.

lines.zh: 我这样的身子，也想有人陪。
lines.en: Even a body like mine wants company.
I'm still just an ordinary child.
Live with me!
The Nether wastes are cold — stay with me.
Stay with me for safety!
We share a cave!
Live with me!
We are the best partners!
Come, let's be together!

lines.zh: 积攒着黑曜石碎片的肩膀沉重
lines.en: Heavy shoulders holding obsidian shards

lines.zh: 低沉的咕噜声从喉咙中吐出
lines.en: Low rumbles escape its throat

lines.zh: 坚硬的爪子抓着地上的黑曜石
lines.en: Claws gripped obsidian on the ground

lines.zh: 注视着你，眼神中充满警惕
lines.en: Staring with alert eyes

lines.zh: 缓慢移动，仿佛时间静止
lines.en: Moving slowly, as if time stands still

lines.zh: 耳朵轻微抖动，听到微小声音
lines.en: Ears twitch to tiny sounds

lines.zh: 嘴巴轻启，发出低沉的呜咽声
lines.en: Mouth opens, letting out low wails

lines.zh: 盯着远方，似乎在寻找什么东西
lines.en: Staring into the distance

lines.zh: 用粗糙的手触摸身边的黑曜石
lines.en: Touching obsidian nearby with rough hands

lines.zh: 低垂的头颅，似乎在沉思
lines.en: Lowering its head in thought

lines.zh: 注意到你，眼神中闪过一丝好奇
lines.en: Noticing you, curiosity flickers in its eyes

lines.zh: 缓慢转身，看向你的方向
lines.en: Slowly turning its head towards you
Locking eyes on you, pupils dilate
Approaching slowly, cautiously

lines.zh: 喉咙里发出低沉的声音
lines.en: Throbbing low sounds from its throat

lines.zh: 身体轻微颤抖，似乎在准备什么
lines.en: Body trembling, preparing something

lines.zh: 目光死死盯住你，毫无退缩
lines.en: Staring fixedly at you without flinching

lines.zh: 缓慢地靠近，一步步紧盯着你
lines.en: Approaching slowly, eyes locked on you
Eyes flickering, contemplating

lines.zh: 喉咙里发出沉重的呼吸声
lines.en: Heavy breaths coming from its throat
He looks up and takes you in.

lines.zh: 他往后退了半步，又停住。
lines.en: He steps back half a pace, then stops.
He raises a hand as if to wave.

lines.zh: 他数着你的脚步，慢慢跟。
lines.en: He counts your steps and follows slowly.

lines.zh: 黑曜石碎片在它的手中发出微光
lines.en: Obsidian shards glow faintly in its hands

lines.zh: 手指轻轻抚摸着黑曜石，发出细微声响
lines.en: Fingers touch obsidian, making tiny sounds

lines.zh: 低沉的呼吸声从它口中传出
lines.en: Low breaths escaping its mouth

lines.zh: 凝视着你，眼中映出黑色光芒
lines.en: Staring at you, black light in its eyes

lines.zh: 沉默中，它似乎在思考着什么
lines.en: Silent, it seems to be thinking

lines.zh: 黑曜石碎片在手中轻轻旋转
lines.en: Obsidian shards spin in its hands

lines.zh: 眼中闪烁着黑曜石的光泽
lines.en: Black light in its eyes

lines.zh: 轻柔地抚摸着黑曜石，似乎在安抚自己
lines.en: Gently touching obsidian, calming itself
Breathing becomes increasingly rapid

lines.zh: 眼中光芒渐浓，似乎做出决定
lines.en: Eyes glowing more, decision made
He stares at the sword at your hip.

lines.zh: 他的手在袖子里捏紧了。
lines.en: His hand tightens inside his sleeve.
He hesitates, then takes one step closer.
He opens his mouth and says nothing.
He studies your face as if recalling it.

lines.zh: 下界的热风吹动他的头发。
lines.en: Nether heat stirs his hair.
Sssss, coming!
Tentacles swing, threatening you!
Bit off your head!
Suck you dry!
Mucus spray, scare you!
My fists are no match for demons.
You're going to be sucked away!

lines.zh: 我只有这双手，也要拦住你。
lines.en: These hands are all I have, and I will stop you.
You're about to vanish!

lines.zh: 他扑上来，撞乱了你的架。
lines.en: He lunges and breaks your stance.

lines.zh: 他的指甲刮过你的手腕。
lines.en: His nails rake your wrist.
He snatches a fistful of your coat!
He drives his forehead into your chest.

lines.zh: 他瘦弱的手臂却很有劲。
lines.en: His thin arm is stronger than it looks.
He locks both arms around your leg!
He shoves you off and runs.
Deep in the wasteland, my home.
I appear in the darkness.

lines.zh: 荒原中的裂缝，我的居所。
lines.en: Fracture of the wasteland, my dwelling.
Wasteland, waiting for prey.
At the end of the wasteland, my birth.
In the wasteland, I wait.
Darkness swallows, I appear.
Wasteland, my home.
In the wasteland, I arrive.
At the edge of the wasteland, my start.

lines.zh: 下界荒原上多了个孩子。
lines.en: A child appears on the nether wastes.

lines.zh: 他站在岩浆边，一动不动。
lines.en: He stands at the lava's edge without moving.
Flames burn without end.

lines.zh: 跌落深渊，再也无法起身。
lines.en: Fell into abyss, unable to rise.
Devoured by flames, no escape.
Explosion pain is unbearable.
Arrow pierces, pain unbearable.
Magical fire consumes me.
Starvation pains more than death.
Lightning strikes, pain floods.
Void pain endures forever.
